subject: english
question:
**Fill in the blank with the most appropriate preposition:**

She persisted ______ all obstacles and criticism, proving her detractors wrong.
solution:
The correct answer is '**through**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The preposition "**through**" is used to indicate movement or persistence across an obstacle or difficulty.
 
• The sentence describes the subject overcoming obstacles and criticism, making "**through**" the most appropriate choice.
